svg.title: Effort per task, A vs B
svg.desc: Which side burns more effort on the same task? Input tokens: haiku ts-off 413.3M, haiku ts-on 101.2M over 800 shared tasks; haiku ts-on spent more on 25.

g.text: Each dot is one shared task: A's effort across, B's up, on one scale. Above the dashed diagonal B spent more, below
it A did. Colour says who passed.
